Make vcupp bootstrap resilient to failed upgrades

Replace the autoloads-based bootstrap with a direct add-to-list
'load-path.  This only depends on the vcupp directory existing
(guaranteed after git pull), unlike loading vcupp-autoloads.el which
can be missing if package-vc--unpack-1 failed silently during a
package-vc-upgrade.

fix: add :main-file to monorepo VC packages and nongnu to archives

Monorepo packages (clojure-mode, embark, embark-consult, wgrep)
without :main-file cause package-vc--unpack-1 to scan all .el files,
picking up circular self-dependencies from sub-package headers. This
triggers archive-based installs that fail when the archive URL is
missing. Adding :main-file restricts scanning to the correct file.

Also add nongnu to package-archives in settings.el since some
transitive deps may reside there.

Migrate from MELPA to package-vc for all packages

Replace MELPA with use-package :vc declarations so all packages fetch
latest commits from source repos during bootstrap. This eliminates the
MELPA dependency entirely -- only GNU ELPA remains (for vcl-mode).

Key changes:
- Convert ~48 packages from versioned ELPA releases to :vc
- Add package-vc advices for monorepo compilation (#5) and pre-release
  version parsing (#4, e.g. sesman "0.3.3-DEV")
- Handle VC packages with subdirectories (corfu, vertico, cider)
- Move submodule packages (eglot presets, majutsu, etc.) to :vc
- Add install-packages.sh, test-packages.el, test-startup-time.el
- Remove NonGNU ELPA from package-archives (nothing uses it)
- Update my-preload-package to find VC package directories

Update eglot-typescript-preset and eglot-python-preset submodules
